title: Give each brand its own currency contract

cases.says: a purchase in a currency both contracts cover goes on to be approved, for either brand
a purchase in a currency its brand's contract doesn't cover is declined with that group's code, and the terminal gets the answer
two participant elements of one class keep their own configuration, so each brand applies its own list and code
a missing or misspelt currencies property is refused at configuration time instead of meaning an empty list

origin.section: 5.4 Each `<participant>` Element Is Its Own Instance, With Its Own Configuration
